descs.t: Early voting in person is underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado, and Donald Trump is telling voters to return mail ballots immediately or vote in person. He has also posted endorsement slates for Senate, governor and House races from Texas to Alaska. We walk through the states he named and the races he is backing.

Donald Trump has turned his feed into an early voting drive, urging voters in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado to vote now and posting full slates for races in Texas, Virginia, North Carolina, Nevada and more. Early votes are already coming in. We look at where he is pushing hardest and why the early vote matters to his side.

Early voting is underway and Donald Trump is calling on Republicans to stop waiting: return the mail ballot now or go vote in person. From Ken Paxton in Texas to the governor races in Arizona and Nevada, he has named the candidates he wants elected. We break down the slate and what is at stake if his voters stay home.

intro.plain: Early voting in person is now underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado, and President Trump is telling voters to return mail ballots immediately or go vote. He has also posted endorsement lists for races from Texas to Alaska. So let me ask the chat: have you already voted early, or are you waiting for Election Day?
intro.mid: President Trump has turned his posts into an early voting drive. South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona, Colorado, all open now, and he is posting full slates of candidates state by state, Texas, Virginia, Nevada, Alaska. That tells you how much his side is counting on the early vote. Chat, which race on his list worries you the most?
intro.bold: Early voting is open and President Trump is not being subtle: return your mail ballot now or go vote in person. He has named his candidates in state after state, Ken Paxton in Texas, Andy Biggs in Arizona, Joe Lombardo in Nevada. If his voters stay home, those races are in play. Chat, tell me your state and whether you have voted yet.

hook.plain: Early voting in person is now underway in South Carolina, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado. President Trump is telling voters to act now. Here are the states and the races he named.
hook.mid: President Trump is posting candidate slates state by state while early voting opens. That tells you exactly where his side thinks this election will be won or lost. Let's look at the list.
hook.bold: Return the ballot now or go vote in person. That is President Trump's message as early voting opens. Here are the races he is asking them to win.

descs.t: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas has been charged with drug trafficking and money laundering, the Justice Department says, and seven people were arrested or surrendered in the case. We go through what prosecutors allege and what happens next.

Louise Lucas, the Democratic President Pro Tempore of the Virginia Senate, is in federal custody on RICO, drug trafficking, money laundering, fraud and firearms charges. Her lawyer calls it political payback, and AG Todd Blanche says the Justice Department does not do political paybacks. We walk through the indictment and both sides of that fight.

An FBI wiretap allegedly caught Virginia state Sen. Louise Lucas saying "This is our last chance at generational wealth." Now the lawmaker who pushed to redraw Virginia's congressional maps faces federal RICO and money laundering charges. We go through what prosecutors say the enterprise did.

intro.plain: Virginia state Senator Louise Lucas has been arrested and charged with drug trafficking and money laundering, according to the Justice Department. Seven people were arrested or surrendered in the case, which prosecutors describe as a RICO conspiracy. These are charges, not a conviction. Tell me in the chat: did you expect this, and what should Virginia Democrats do now?
intro.mid: The President Pro Tempore of the Virginia Senate, Louise Lucas, is now in federal custody. Prosecutors say she ran a marijuana trafficking and money laundering enterprise. Her lawyer calls it political payback. AG Todd Blanche says they do not do political paybacks. So who do you believe? Tell me in the chat.
intro.bold: "This is our last chance at generational wealth." That is what Virginia state Senator Louise Lucas allegedly said on an FBI wiretap. Now she is under arrest on RICO, drug trafficking and money laundering charges, the same lawmaker who pushed to redraw Virginia's congressional maps. Tell me in the chat: should she resign right now?
